summary.text: Elliott Herneker is the Republican candidate for the Maryland House of Delegates, District 34A, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the June 23, 2026 Republican primary.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a lifelong Harford County resident who works as a supervisor at UPS in Aberdeen and chairs the Harford County Young Republicans.

paragraphs.text: Herneker said in a Ballotpedia survey that he graduated from Harford Technical High School, earned an associate degree in political science from Harford Community College and a bachelor's degree from the University of Maryland Global Campus.
He said he has worked at UPS in Aberdeen for five years and interned for former Governor Larry Hogan's 2024 U.S. Senate campaign.
Herneker named the cost of living, thoughtful growth and housing affordability, and a strong local economy as his key messages.
He said he supports reducing unnecessary permitting delays, supporting first-time homebuyers, and reducing regulatory burdens on small businesses.
